results.title: Filipino embalmers – last caretakers of the dead, seldom cared for
results.content: Part 2: Trainers say a decade of reforms professionalized the embalming industry, but regulation, data, and pay have not kept pace

results.title: [New Rx] What if the Philippines leased an island for 100 years?
results.content: Hong Kong can be a model. Singapore and South Korea might bring in long-term capital, drive regional economic growth, and spark broader national governance reforms in the Philippines
